The '''Golden Pylat Award''' was an award that shared its name with<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|147|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Devious Neimoidians Revealed}}</ref> the [[Pylat bird/Legends|Neimoidian pylat bird]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|51|pylat bird}}</ref> Prior to<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]]&ndash;led<ref name="DB">{{DB|species|neimoidian|Neimoidian}}</ref> [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Trade Federation Occupation Council]]'s [[chronicler]], the Neimoidian [[Viff Almay]], wrote a biography of [[Trade Baron]] [[Uunos Gooru]], for which she won the Golden Pylat Award.<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
On [[January 21]], [[2014]],<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/147|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #147}}</ref> the Golden Pylat Award was introduced in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|The Devious Neimoidians Revealed]]," an article written for the [[Star Wars Insider 147|147th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />
